row.evidence: Precoro lists SSO and API access from the Automation plan (from $999/month billed annually) and documents SAML SSO set up as a custom SAML app with users assigned in the IdP, but no SCIM or automated user provisioning.
row.notes: New row. Procure-to-pay software. Flat platform pricing, not per user: Core from $499/month and Automation from $999/month billed annually, Enterprise custom with 'Unlimited users'; a separate AP Module (from $499/month) also lists SSO and API access. SAML SSO is on Automation and above (and the AP Module), set up per IdP as a custom SAML app (guides for Entra ID, Okta, PingOne, Keycloak, JumpCloud and any SAML IdP); admins can then turn off Google sign-in. No SCIM, JIT or directory sync is documented: users are added and invited by admins in User Management and deactivated by hand with a Substitute who inherits their documents (history kept, drafts deleted). The REST API (personal X-AUTH-TOKEN key, 60 requests/minute, 1,500/hour, 3,000/day) only reads users (GET /users). Status none by absence.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Flat platform price. SSO and API access are listed only from Automation.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Everything in Automation plus unlimited users and advanced admin controls.

plans.name: AP Module
plans.notes: Separate accounts-payable product line on the AP Automation tab; shown in the default render of the pricing page.

scim.notes: Not offered: SSO guides cover SAML only and users must be added in Precoro and assigned to the IdP app; help-centre sitemap (443 articles) has no SCIM or provisioning article.

capabilities.notes: The Postman reference's Configuration/Users folder has only Get Users list.

rate_limits.text: 60 requests per minute; 1,500 per hour; 3,000 per day; stricter limits for duplicate requests.

okta.notes: Precoro's Okta guide creates a new SAML App Integration (custom app); https://www.okta.com/integrations/precoro/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Precoro publishes an Entra ID SSO guide; no Precoro entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorials index.

jumpcloud.notes: Vendor guide uses JumpCloud's Custom SAML App option, so there is no catalogue app.

fallbacks.notes: Users are added or invited by admins in User Management and must also be assigned to the IdP app; JIT is not documented.
